title: data/actors/index.json
description: Every published actor, one row each. The actors list, search and the prerendered actor pages read it.

id.description: The actor's ID, which is also the name of its file under actors/.

name.description: The ATT&CK name when ATT&CK tracks the actor, otherwise the name most sources use.

aliases.description: The published aliases, in the order the actor page lists them.

origin.description: Distinct origin values across published sources. More than one value means the sources disagree, and the actor page shows who said what.

report_count.description: Published reports tagged with this actor, dated or not.

last_reported.description: The newest publication date among those reports, or null when none is dated.

sources.description: Sources that contributed a published fact about this actor.

actorId.description: An ATT&CK group ID such as G0007, or a lower-case ASCII slug for an actor ATT&CK does not track. The ID is also the actor's file name and URL segment, so it has no colons, slashes or spaces, and it is never 'index'.

label.description: Non-empty text with no leading or trailing whitespace and no line breaks.

nullableDate.description: A date, or null when none is known.

sourceKey.description: A connector key such as attack or misp, as listed in sources.json. Never a display name.
